title: Support realization coherence for strict scalar comparison
statement: For a coefficient chain E → F → L, compact-support data SE, SF, SL and ramification indices e, h: the L/F image-tower comparison, followed by the L-image of the tower associator and of the L/E reduction balancing, the inverse L-selection through the image and the inverse L support model, equals the F/E reduction balancing, F-selection and inverse F support model under T_{L/F}, followed by the selection square, the retained L/F arrow, the reassociation of retained levels and the support image of the completed associator.

source.place: Returned comparison Step 11, proof Steps 3--6: support realization after strict image-tower mate pasting.

proof.text: Expand the retained L/F arrow. The selection square is the localized identity square and cancels the F support-model pair. Arithmetic selection acts termwise on the ordinary proper/open mates, so it commutes with the L/F comparison; naturality of that comparison moves the F/E balancing in front. The remaining isomorphisms agree: the reduction balancings compose by uniqueness in reductionBalancing_existsUnique (ordinary balancings compose by ((x⊗b)⊗d)↦x⊗bd), the image selections for e and h compose through compositionRetained, and the L support model is natural in compositionCompleted.

proof_origin.place: Returned comparison Step 11, support realization portion of Steps 3--6.

from.place: Returned comparison Step 11, Steps 3--6 support realization.

theorem supportRealization_coherence
    (c : Compactification f)
    (SE : CoefficientDerivedSystemCalculus.{u, u} l E X)
    (SF : CoefficientDerivedSystemCalculus.{u, u} l F X)
    (SL : CoefficientDerivedSystemCalculus.{u, u} l L X)
    (e h : ℕ) (he : PurCompactSupport.Ramification l E F i e) (hepos : 1 ≤ e)
    (hh : PurCompactSupport.Ramification l F L j h) (hhpos : 1 ≤ h)
    (M : DerivedCategory (scalarReductionSource l E X)) :
    (comparison l F L j c).app
        ((T l E F i X).obj ((reduction l E X SE).obj M)) ≫
      (image l L c).map ((compositionTower l E F i L j X).hom.app
        ((reduction l E X SE).obj M)) ≫
      (image l L c).map
        ((reductionBalancing l E L (j.comp i) X SE SL (h * e)
          (compositionRamification l E F i L j e h he hh) (one_le_mul hhpos hepos)).hom.app M) ≫
      (reindexImage l L c (h * e) (one_le_mul hhpos hepos)).inv.app
        ((reduction l L X SL).obj
          ((pbcDerivedExtend (completedCoefficientMap l E L (j.comp i) X)).obj M)) ≫
      (subsequence l L Y (h * e)).map
        ((supportModel l L c SL).inv.app
          ((pbcDerivedExtend (completedCoefficientMap l E L (j.comp i) X)).obj M)) =
    (T l F L j Y).map
        ((image l F c).map
          ((reductionBalancing l E F i X SE SF e he hepos).hom.app M)) ≫
      (T l F L j Y).map
        ((reindexImage l F c e hepos).inv.app
          ((reduction l F X SF).obj
            ((pbcDerivedExtend (completedCoefficientMap l E F i X)).obj M))) ≫
      (T l F L j Y).map
        ((subsequence l F Y e).map
          ((supportModel l F c SF).inv.app
            ((pbcDerivedExtend (completedCoefficientMap l E F i X)).obj M))) ≫
      (compositionSelection l F L j Y e).hom.app
        ((support l F c SF).obj
          ((pbcDerivedExtend (completedCoefficientMap l E F i X)).obj M)) ≫
      (subsequence l L Y e).map
        ((arrow l F L j c SF SL h hh hhpos).app
          ((pbcDerivedExtend (completedCoefficientMap l E F i X)).obj M)) ≫
      (compositionRetained l L Y e h hepos hhpos).hom.app
        ((support l L c SL).obj
          ((pbcDerivedExtend (completedCoefficientMap l F L j X)).obj
            ((pbcDerivedExtend (completedCoefficientMap l E F i X)).obj M))) ≫
      (subsequence l L Y (h * e)).map
        ((support l L c SL).map
          ((compositionCompleted l E F i L j X).hom.app M))
